title: Pyrotechnic Villager
description: It's a mod that adds a new villager variation (Pyrotechnic)
body:
dds a brand-new flight specialist villager focused entirely on aerial progression. This custom villager offers rockets, Elytras, and other flight-related items in exchange for valuable resources.

Designed to make flight more accessible without completely removing progression balance, this mod provides an alternative way to obtain Elytras without relying exclusively on End exploration. Players can trade for different tiers of rockets and essential aerial equipment, making long-distance travel and sky exploration more dynamic.

The villager integrates naturally into the game and can be assigned a custom profession with its own workstation. Trades are balanced to maintain challenge while rewarding dedicated players.

Perfect for survival worlds, multiplayer servers, and modpacks that want expanded trading options or a smoother path to flight.
